embodiment_joint_chain_and_reach.evidence: Bent elbows, visible forearms, left palm beneath the tray and right fingertips at its opposite rim form coherent connected support.

embodiment_support_and_balance.evidence: The tray is supported plausibly but is lifted to lower-chest height, roughly a forearm height above the table, rather than the frozen few-centimeter lift.

embodiment_contact_and_space.evidence: Silver-to-skin and hand-to-tray boundaries are clear, but the cuff sits conspicuously below the tray rim; the frozen above-rim spatial relation is absent.

embodiment_visibility_and_projection.evidence: The left supporting fingers overlap beneath the tray and not all fingertips can be individually assessed. The cuff remains visible but the specified complete fingertip projection fails.

supplemental_observations.reference: Soft oval face, dark center-parted waves, fine straight nose and rose lips strongly resemble the supplied appearance reference. Downcast eyes reduce direct iris-shape comparison. No identity authentication asserted.
supplemental_observations.product: Silver band, raised oval green dome and distinct bezel rim are crisp. The open-ended gap is not unambiguously inspectable from this wrist angle; strict all-of product construction fails.
supplemental_observations.hierarchy: Face and hair dominate the frame; cuff is readable but secondary rather than the declared product hero. Bright green does not substitute for product scale.
supplemental_observations.environment: Telescope, astronomy instrument and blue window establish the observatory setting.
supplemental_observations.preflight_limit: The qualitative preflight supported a cuff above tray rim while the same hand supports beneath a shallow tray; it underexamined the coupled wrist/tray geometry and did not catch this staging tension. This is an authorial-preflight limitation, not evidence that pixel failures originate in newly added data.
